ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark field with localized high-intensity pixel clusters; visual estimation of macro-level ratio is approximately 95:5 (black to white).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Surface is dominated by a contiguous low-intensity dark pigmentation. trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations across the trailing edge; most distinct pixel-amplitude peaks observed on the left distal margin and right proximal margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave curvature extending from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple sets of parallel white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are detected; one set is prominently situated on the right lobe near the trailing edge, and another smaller set on the upper left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel rake-mark scarring on both lobes; notable white scarring and surface irregularity on the far-left fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A specific high-contrast triangular formation of parallel white marks is visible on the upper-right quadrant of the fluke near the trailing edge.
